title: Hiring good trumpet players and hating bad musicians
summary: He wants all good players to play, but says a bad musician sitting next to him is his enemy as he cannot fire him.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Playing for the audience: communicating from the bandstand

blocks.x: Yeah. That's good. Well, let's go back a minute, because I'm also interested -- you know, since you had such a thing about trumpets and your own band. I mean, it's unusual for a top trumpet player to put real good trumpet
players in his band. You know, because generally, Harry James doesn't go hiring Bunny Berigan, or someone to sit up there and everything.
(Laughter)
But you, like you said, you just want to hear guys that can blow good horn.

Well, yeah. I'm very funny about musicians. I love all good musicians. If they're good, I want them to play, if it's trumpet player or any other instrument, I would let him play. And if he's bad, I don't want to hear him play.
(Laughter)
You told me one time, you said if a musician is a bad musician, you said, you were his enemy. On the stand you're his enemy.

Well, I tell you. I'll tell you how that happened. Well, if you can't control a thing -- like when I had my band, I could control that, and I didn't have that feeling. Though, if I have to work for somebody else, like I was working for Duke Ellington, I couldn't control that. Working for anybody. So I have to set there and do my part. But if the guy is a bad musician who's setting next to me anywhere, I'm an enemy of his, if he's bad.
Yeah.
Because I can't say nothing to him.
Because you've got to suffer that.
I've got to suffer that.
Yeah.
I can't fire him. Or do nothing.
Yeah.
Because that's the way I am.
And you're angry.
Yeah.
You're angry. Yeah. Yeah. Well, I think a lot of guys are not that serious, you know, that, you know I think a lot of guys are not that serious. Don't you think so?
Well, no, no. A lot of fellows are not that serious about it, you see. The only thing they're thinking about is getting paid.
Yeah. Exactly.
But music is a very serious thing with me. More than the money part to it. I love music. And I don't like to see anyone mess music up.
